author: chipsahoy
text_post: I'm with oldskoolpunk on this one. I've done some singles mixers before (not done by online dating sites though) and some speed dating events. The bottom line is that they work well mostly as a fun evening out, i.e. better than doing nothing, but don't expect high value women there - mostly losers.  The one or two super looking women will be hawked by a lot of guys, and will probably end up leaving early. So if you spot one, get to them early, don't wait - they will either be gone before you know it, or in a group of men circling them. I HIGHLY SUGGEST GOING WITH FRIENDS, for several reasons: A) you will look pretty bad going alone, B) if there is no one else worthwhile to talk to then you will at least have your friends, C) after the night is over, you can have a good time with your friends joking about how good/bad/stupid it was, D) you will look good among friends (assuming they look good...hah). I don't know how mixers sponsored by dating sites are compared to generic ones (I've only been to generic ones). With generic ones, signups are 100% public, so people will sign up with groups of friends. Approaching girls you want to target becomes difficult as you have to deal with their (usually) ugly friends. Perhaps dating-site sponsored ones are different since it is limited to members, less likely to have groups of friends and more people going solo? Not sure. "Don't go in expecting anything to come from it" and "go with friends" is the best advice I can give you.
